question: How old must a person be to become a naturalized U.S. citizen?
explanation: Being 18 is the first requirement the study guide lists. The others include being a lawful permanent resident and passing the naturalization test and interview.

source.title: One Nation, One People: The USCIS 2025 Civics Test Study Guide
source.quote_under_25_words: be 18 years old

question: Ahmed writes a letter to a newspaper criticizing a new policy. Which First Amendment freedom is he using?
options: The right to a jury trial
explanation: Freedom of speech lets people say or write what they think without fear of jail. Writing to a newspaper is one way to take part in American democracy.

source.title: One Nation, One People: The USCIS 2025 Civics Test Study Guide

question: People in the United States have the right to practice any religion, or not to practice one.
explanation: Freedom of religion is one of the five freedoms in the First Amendment. It protects practicing a religion and also choosing not to.

source.title: One Nation, One People: The USCIS 2025 Civics Test Study Guide
source.quote_under_25_words: People in the U.S. have the right to practice any religion, or not practice a religion.

question: Voting in federal elections is a right of everyone living in the United States, citizen or not.
explanation: Some rights belong to everyone living in the country, but voting in federal elections is only for U.S. citizens. It is how citizens choose representatives, senators and the President.

source.title: One Nation, One People: The USCIS 2025 Civics Test Study Guide
source.quote_under_25_words: voting in federal elections is a right and a responsibility that is only for U.S. citizens

question: According to the study guide, between which ages must men register for the Selective Service?
explanation: Men who are citizens or legal residents must register for the Selective Service. The duty applies between the ages of 18 and 26.
